{'content': '自從 Jony Ive 於 2019 年離開 Apple 以來，公司一直欠缺一位真正的設計總監。有一段時間，前營運總監 Jeff Williams 曾主管設計事務，直至他去年離任。此後，行政總裁 John Ternus 對 Apple 旗下兩個設計團隊——工業設計及人機介面——均展現出高度關注，據 Bloomberg 的 Mark Gurman 報導。', 'notes': ''}

{'content': 'This story actually begins before John Ternus even became CEO, just a month ago. It all started when Jeff Williams stepped down as COO. At the time, the company announced that the relevant teams would report to former CEO Tim Cook, but in reality, according to reports, it was John Ternus who took over. This was one of his key responsibilities during his transition to CEO.', 'notes': ''}

{'content': "It should come as no surprise that Ternus is interested in design, given that he previously headed up hardware engineering. However, Gurman describes Ternus's level of involvement as 'immersed,' and he personally visits and works alongside the teams from time to time:", 'notes': ''}

{'content': 'This stands in stark contrast to former CEO Tim Cook, who reportedly visited the design department on average only once a month, according to Bloomberg.', 'notes': ''}

{'content': "Ternus 'Immersed' in Apple's Design Teams", 'notes': ''}

{'content': "Ternus is also actively reshaping the design team's staffing, as the company has lost a significant number of talent in recent years to external companies. Among the most notable departures, Alan Dye jumped ship to Meta, and OpenAI has also poached a large number of employees from Apple. To reinvigorate team morale, Apple has promoted several junior designers and brought in new blood from outside.", 'notes': ''}

{'content': 'Top Liked Comment by JP', 'notes': ''}

{'content': 'No red flags so far about this person. He seems to combine some of the strengths of past and current executives.', 'notes': ''}

{'content': 'Despite all of the above, the company has yet to actively search for a true successor to Jony Ive to fill a position similar to Chief Design Officer. According to Bloomberg, the company is not currently conducting any recruitment procedures. Instead, the company has appointed Molly Anderson and Steve Lemay as the heads of industrial design and human interface design, respectively, while Ternus personally serves as the top decision-maker on design matters.', 'notes': ''}

{'content': 'While Ternus lacks a traditional design background, his emphasis on design means one thing: design will continue to be a core cornerstone at the highest levels of Apple.', 'notes': ''}
